about_the_game:
The Best Thief

In this fun, competitive game, you’ll become a daring thief ready to do anything for the ultimate score. With valuables under tight guard, time running out, and rivals scheming against you, show the city who’s the greatest!

Many Modes, Endless Fun

Dive into heists and game modes galore. Master every challenge or escape the chaos with your head held high—if you can!

Stealing is a Blast

Compete with friends or strangers: push, shoot, explode, sabotage, destroy, and hide. Rack up points to claim the champion’s crown, but remember—it’s the chaos along the way that counts!

Style is Everything

Who says thieves need masks and black outfits? Pull off heists in a koala suit, alien gear, coconut shell… or just a paper bag. This city’s never seen style like yours!

Go Solo or Team Up

Assemble a dream team of four or fly solo. Pull off brilliant (or hilariously messy) heists to dominate the thieves’ championship and climb the leaderboards!

“Events in this game are 100% authentic. That’s how I operate.”

– Self-proclaimed “World’s Greatest Thief”

“The best game ever! My son plays it non-stop!”

– Mom of one of the devs

“Please stop poking the round trap. Seriously.”

– A tired tester

name: Steal Out

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7500F / AMD Ryzen 3600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / RX750
  • DirectX: Version 9.0

short_description: A chaotic, laugh-out-loud game for up to 4 players! Pull off an epic heist and escape before you’re caught! Dodge traps, crack safes, and steal loot from rivals. Most importantly — have an absolute blast!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Japanese
